item: Water-cooled chiller >400 kW (755 kW), fixed O&M
source: Heat Roadmap Europe D3.2: Cooling technology datasheets in the 14 MSs in the EU28 (Dittmann, Riviere, Stabat)
publisher: Mines ParisTech - ARMINES / Heat Roadmap Europe (H2020)
quote: Water-cooled chillers > 400 kW ... Cold generation capacity (kW) 755 ... Fixed O&M (EUR/unit/year) 3503 [2015 column]
conversion: 3503 EUR/yr / 0.755 MW = 4639.7 EUR/MW/yr; 2015 column read as 2015 prices, HICP factor 1
note: Service-sector water-cooled screw/centrifugal chiller; fixed O&M includes reinvestments within the lifetime (p.? method section). Price year assumed = the 2015 column.

source: Tri-County Technical College - District Chilled Water Study
quote: $ 20 per ton per year for maintenance for district chiller plant
conversion: 20 USD/ton/yr / 3.5169 kW/ton = 5687 USD/MW/yr; / 1.3281 USD/EUR (ECB 2013 average) = 4282 EUR/MW/yr (2013); x 1.00624 (HICP 2013->2015, as other 2013 rows) = 4309
note: US planning figure (last update 5/14/2013); labour and material, routine maintenance averaged per year. ECB rate to be checked.

item: Production ESP, replacement every 5 years (DoubletCalc default)
source: Costs of Deep Geothermal Energy in the Netherlands (MSc thesis, D. Straathof)
quote: The sharp peaks every five years are due to the replacement of the ESP, which is a necessary but relatively expensive operation.
conversion: One replacement per 5 years = 1/5 = 20 %/yr of the ESP capex, assuming a workover costs about one ESP (the thesis gives no amount); no currency, so no HICP step
note: EBN ESP workshop 2025 reports average Dutch ESP run times of about 1-2 years, i.e. 50-100 %/yr; 20 %/yr is the low end.
